nodes.label: FIREWORK CHRONOS
nodes.rationale: Turns 25 years of MODIS+VIIRS detections into one calibrated burning calendar in VIIRS-equivalent fire cell-days with uncertainty bands, source labels and blind-spot warnings; urgent because Suomi NPP stops Nov 2026 and Terra/Aqua MODIS end 2027.

nodes.label: Why now: MODIS/VIIRS mission end dates
nodes.rationale: Once MODIS stops, the older half of the record can no longer be checked against a second instrument.
nodes.norm_label: why now: modis/viirs mission end dates

nodes.label: Punjab-Haryana late-burning story (iFOREST 2025)
nodes.rationale: >90% of large Punjab farm fires after 3 PM vs overpasses at ~10:30/13:30; burnt area fell slower than counts, so a count-only calendar would wrongly show collapse.

nodes.label: Judging criteria (Influence, Creativity, Validity, Relevance, Presentation)
nodes.norm_label: judging criteria (influence, creativity, validity, relevance, presentation)

nodes.label: Competitor: FireCal
nodes.rationale: global 0.1 deg cell-days, LOYO; no industrial separation/diurnal bias

nodes.label: Competitor: Kiln Watch
nodes.rationale: Bangladesh cloud-normalised cell-days with seam test; one country

nodes.label: Rule: Code style (beginner-readable)
nodes.rationale: React limited to useState/useEffect/useParams/useNavigate/props/.map/.filter/.find, if/else before return, no ternaries, no comments, no custom hooks, no new packages without asking, full files.

nodes.label: Rule: Data honesty
nodes.rationale: Never invent numbers; every number from API; meta.demo drives DEMO chip; failures show CACHED/unavailable never zero; LLM writes words not numbers.

nodes.label: Rule: Security and git
nodes.rationale: Keys only in .env/platform secrets; never commit data/raw; one branch per milestone; uploads <=25MB allow-listed, never executed.

nodes.label: Rule: Exact look first (design reference is ground truth)

nodes.label: Rule: Keep AI memory small (read index/graph first)

nodes.rationale: Factories/flares burn year-round and would inflate agricultural season and distort calibration; UNKNOWN is a valid answer (abstain <0.55).

nodes.rationale: Answers the Punjab story where counts fell while burnt area fell slowly.

nodes.rationale: One calibrated burning calendar from 25 years of MODIS+VIIRS detections on a VIIRS-equivalent fire cell-day scale with uncertainty band, fire-source label and blind-spot warning.

nodes.rationale: Tries sources in order, skips sources failed in last 10 minutes, checks quality, caches, returns {data, meta} with source used.
